title: UnifiedActivity - Data API
description: Represents an activity that is automatically captured from Einstein Activity Capture (EAC) or other activity data, such as calls, manually logged tasks, and emails. This object consists of fields common to all types of activity-related objects such as Event, Task, EmailMessage, VoiceCall, VideoCall, and so on. This object is available for reports and dashboards in the Winter ’24 release and later.

ActivityDateTime.description: The date and time of the activity in the Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) time zone.

ActivitySubType.description: Provides standard subtypes to facilitate creating and searching for specific activity subtypes. Possible values are: Captured LegacyCall Streamed VoiceCall

ActivityType.description: The type of activity. Possible values are: UnifiedActivity UnifiedEmail UnifiedMeeting UnifiedTask UnifiedVideoCall UnifiedVoiceCall

DetailId.description: The ID of the object that contains detailed activity-specific information. The object depends on the activity type. For example, the detail for a Task activity is a Task object. The detail for an Event activity is an Event object. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

IsInsightAvailable.description: Indicates whether the activity has an insight associated with it (true) or not (false). The default value is false.

Snippet.description: An abbreviation of the activity body or description. This field has a maximum length of 255 characters.

Subject.description: Contains the subject of the task or event.
